summary.text: Colby Lopez is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026, and works in retail.

paragraphs.text: Colby Lopez was born in Summersville, West Virginia, and graduated from Oak Hill High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Fayette County, graduated from high school in 2019, and attended WVU Tech as a business management major without yet finishing his degree, serving in student government as senator, treasurer, vice president and president.
He described himself in the survey as a registered Democrat who would serve as an independent Democrat outside the major party caucuses.
Lopez said in the survey that his three key messages are a fair economy for West Virginians, protecting natural resources and fiscal moderation.
He said he focuses on economic policy that benefits workers, small businesses and people in poverty.
